description: Draw the CG33090 transcript models from Ensembl Metazoa exon coordinates, showing that CG33090-RC starts from a distinct internal first exon whose coding part is 83 bp, matching the 28 PC-specific residues
code:
import requests, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"Accept":"application/json"})
g=S.get("https://rest.ensembl.org/lookup/id/FBgn0028916?expand=1;content-type=application/json",timeout=60).json()
T={}
for t in g["Transcript"]:
    tr=S.get(f"https://rest.ensembl.org/lookup/id/{t['id']}?expand=1;content-type=application/json",timeout=60).json()
    T[t["display_name"]]=dict(exons=sorted([(e["start"],e["end"],e["id"]) for e in tr["Exon"]]),
                              cds=(tr["Translation"]["start"],tr["Translation"]["end"]),
                              aa=tr["Translation"]["length"], tid=t["id"])
json.dump({k:{kk:vv for kk,vv in v.items()} for k,v in T.items()}, open("out/cg33090_transcripts.json","w"))

for k in ["CG33090-RB","CG33090-RC","CG33090-RD","CG33090-RE"]:
    v=T[k]; shared=sum(1 for s,e,i in v["exons"] if i.startswith("FBtr0080624"))
    print(f"{k} {v['tid']} aa={v['aa']} exons={len(v['exons'])} shared_with_RB={shared} cds={v['cds']}")
rc=T["CG33090-RC"]; e1=rc["exons"][0]
print("\nRC first exon", e1, "length", e1[1]-e1[0]+1)
print("RC 5' UTR inside that exon:", rc["cds"][0]-e1[0], "bp; coding part of the exon:", e1[1]-rc["cds"][0]+1,
      "bp =", (e1[1]-rc["cds"][0]+1)/3, "codons")
rb=T["CG33090-RB"]
print("RB exon1:", rb["exons"][0], " RB exon2:", rb["exons"][1])
print("RC first exon lies between RB exon 2 (ends %d) and exon 3 (starts %d)"%(rb["exons"][1][1], rb["exons"][2][0]))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12,3.4))
order=["CG33090-RB","CG33090-RD","CG33090-RE","CG33090-RC"]
for y,k in enumerate(order):
    v=T[k]; ys=len(order)-1-y
    xs=[e[0] for e in v["exons"]]+[e[1] for e in v["exons"]]
    ax.hlines(ys,min(xs),max(xs),color="#999",lw=1)
    for s,e,i in v["exons"]:
        uniq = not i.startswith("FBtr0080624")
        col = "#c0392b" if (k=="CG33090-RC" and uniq) else ("#e59866" if uniq else "#5d8aa8")
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((s,ys-0.22),e-s,0.44,color=col))
    ax.plot([v["cds"][0]],[ys],marker="v",color="k",ms=7)
    ax.text(g["start"]-250,ys,f"{k} ({v['aa']} aa)",ha="right",va="center",fontsize=9)
ax.plot([],[],color="#5d8aa8",lw=6,label="exon shared with CG33090-RB")
ax.plot([],[],color="#e59866",lw=6,label="transcript-specific exon variant")
ax.plot([],[],color="#c0392b",lw=6,label="CG33090-RC alternative first exon")
ax.plot([],[],marker="v",color="k",ls="none",label="CDS start")
ax.set_xlim(g["start"]-3000,g["end"]+500); ax.set_ylim(-0.7,len(order)-0.3)
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlabel("chromosome 2L position (bp)")
ax.set_title("CG33090 transcript models: PC comes from an internal first exon, not a shortened PB")
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
